# CHROMA / Signal Remix

- `cover.svg`: original CHROMA publication artwork by ChefZC/Codex, generated from the project’s own palette and locally bundled fonts. Decorative instrument study; no visitor telemetry.
- `pro-zh.png`, `pro-en.png`, `simple-zh.png`, `mini.png`: selected actual installed CHROMA 0.1.0 screenshots from the local project QA run, September 22, 2026. Readings are point-in-time values on the developer’s computer, not a benchmark or live website measurement.
- Chakra Petch and Silkscreen: local Fontsource files from CHROMA. SIL Open Font License notices included beside the fonts.
- Raw hardware/process exports and QA profiles are excluded from the website and GitHub source.
